## Installing

```bash
# Homebrew (macOS, Linux)
brew install fission-systems/tap/fission-cli

# Install script (macOS, Linux): installs into ~/.local and checks the SHA-256
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/example/Fission/main/install.sh | sh
```

**Cargo** builds from source. The processor specifications and signatures come
from this release:

```bash
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/example/Fission --tag v1.2.0 fission-cli
mkdir -p ~/.cargo/share/fission
curl -fsSL https://github.com/example/Fission/releases/download/v1.2.0/fission-resources.tar.gz \
  | tar -xz -C ~/.cargo/share/fission
```

**Archives** are attached to the release for five targets:

| Platform | Archive |
| --- | --- |
| Linux x86-64 | `fission-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 | `fission-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| macOS Apple silicon | `fission-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS Intel | `fission-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Windows x64 | `fission-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |

Unpack one anywhere and run `bin/fission_cli`; it finds `share/fission/` next
to itself. `SHA256SUMS` covers every asset.

## Measured evidence

Quoted verbatim from each PR's Benchmark, Measurement or Correctness Evidence section. Each number was measured by that PR, under its own load; nothing here is added up or compared across PRs. DecBench scores measure similarity to the source, not correctness (ADR 0018).

```text
verify --tier ground-truth on gzip -O0: diverged 14 -> 3
```

From #102 (Benchmark Impact):

```text
| config | before | after |

| O0 | 1,605 | 1,544 |
```
